newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Rates steady and thinly quoted.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Rates steady and thinly quoted.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were mostly steady on Thursday amid thin activity on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session Monday.
No barges traded versus none on Wednesday.
- Two barges, McGregor and South, Mid-Mississippi River, next week, bid 115 percent of tariff, no comparison, no offer.
- Two barges, Mid-Mississippi River, next week, bid 115 percent, unchanged from July 23, offer 120 percent, unchanged.
- Five barges, McGregor and South, Mid-Mississippi River, one each week of August, bid 122-1/2 percent, no comparison, offer 127-1/2 percent, no comparison.
- 10 barges, Illinois River, two each week of August, no bid, offer 115 percent, down five percentage points, similar.
